name: getdkan/dkan_ai_query
description: Natural-language query for DKAN datasets, built on Drupal AI agents.

suggest.drupal/ai_provider_anthropic: Anthropic provider for the query agent (^1.2). One AI provider module with a configured key is required at runtime.
suggest.drupal/ai_provider_openai: OpenAI provider for the query agent (^1). One AI provider module with a configured key is required at runtime.
